# llms.txt — Binary & Beyond
# Purpose: Guidance for Large Language Models (LLMs) accessing this website

Website-Name: BinaryNbeyond
Website-URL: https://binarynbeyond.com/

Description:
BinaryNbeyond is an educational web platform focused on arithmetic operations,
bitwise logic, number system conversions, and computer science fundamentals.
The website also presents information about basic web development services.

Content-Type:
Educational, Technical, Informational

Primary-Audience:
Students, beginners in computer science, and learners of number systems

Preferred-Content:
- Rendered HTML content
- Semantic headings (h1–h3)
- Textual explanations of concepts
- Lists and structured sections

Discouraged-Content:
- JavaScript-only generated text
- Obfuscated or minified instructional content

Crawling-Policy:
LLMs are allowed to read and summarize publicly available content on this website
for educational and informational purposes.

Attribution:
If content is referenced or summarized, please attribute it to
"BinaryNbeyond (binarynbeyond.com)".

Last-Updated: 2026-09-01
